title: Tool library BOM
description: One row per tool assembly (a cutting tool in its holder), as read from a Mastercam or Fusion tool library.

source.description: Which CAM system the library came from.

shank.description: Inch shanks are numbers (0.5); metric shanks are text in millimetres ("6MM", "2.5MM"). Null when the library has no usable value.

part_number.description: Tool vendor part number. From the library; blank when it can't be found (never guessed).

holder_part_number.description: Holder part number. From the library.

holder_description.description: Holder description. Mastercam only; blank for Fusion.

hyperlink.description: Tool product page. Fusion's product-link when present; otherwise for you to fill in.

quantity.description: How many to buy. Not in either library: for you to fill in. Blank counts as 1 when combining.

holder_hyperlink.description: Holder product page. Fusion's holder product-link when present; otherwise for you to fill in.

collet.description: Sleeve or collet part number. Not in either library: for you to fill in.

spindle_taper.description: e.g. CAT40, HSK63A. Not in either library: for you to fill in.

stickout.description: Tool stickout. Not in either library: for you to fill in.
